project_summary: General-purpose trusted single-user norns/grid emulator on Ubuntu 20.04 WSL2. Official pinned monome runtime. This branch adds opt-in real audio and virtual Crow capabilities. Mosaic and unchanged player mods are external acceptance fixtures. Read docs/delivery/AUDIO.md, docs/AUDIO-DEVICES.md and docs/delivery/completions/A01-tranche1-candidate.md. Default MIDI installation remains unchanged. User explicitly requires verified tranche 1 commit and merge before broader scripts or desktop/Maiden/Docker work.
diff_intent: Review the complete tranche-1 audio/Crow implementation against main: canonical identified experimental build; native engine readiness/default SC server adapters; identified external mods and session-local OSC; bounded real JACK WAV capture/injection; continuous opt-in browser PCM; Crow official ASL/CASL/Detect and ii encoder host with explicit supported subset, bounded serial/capture/trace and cleanup; optional real Mosaic DoubleDecker and JF acceptance. Historical cheat-codes boot feasibility and DESKTOP.md are queue context, not expanded script or desktop implementation claims.
focus: Find substantive reproducible in-scope bugs, misleading acceptance or unsupported claims, source identity or source licensing omissions, runtime readiness/transport/drop issues, session data/process isolation or cleanup defects. Check public API error propagation, continuous browser playback and Crow reset/input/callback/ii bounds. Use actual code and recorded native results. No hostile multi-tenant security, physical hardware certification, finance, mandatory downstream JF DSP, or requests to implement queued Maiden/Docker. One bounded Codex medium review, no convergence. Prioritize blockers/major issues; avoid broad refactoring. Review does not itself prove tests. Give concrete file/line and minimal fixes. Preserve concurrent main docs/delivery/state.json edits. Do not edit files.
